entities.name: Alfonso I of Asturias
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfonso I of Asturias, called the Catholic, was the third king of Asturias, reigning from 739 to his death in 757. His reign saw a great extension of the Christian domain of Asturias, reconquering Galicia and León.
